ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:1.5 ratio of low-intensity black to high-intensity white pixels; dark pigmentation concentrated centrally with high-intensity white dominating the distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation on the distal 70% of both lobes; high-contrast black mottling and a central black wedge near the median notch; distinct black focal spots (approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter) localized on the white background of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree angle, partially obscured by water turbulence at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; notable high-amplitude jagged indentations (valleys) on the distal half of the left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the central notch area toward the tips, tapering to acute, slightly rounded distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the distal white section of the left lobe and vertically on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion of the trailing edge topography; multiple circular scarring events on the mid-right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent cluster of three dark focal spots arranged in a triangular pattern on the distal-mid section of the right lobe.
